central_question: Can an adaptive system increase its future viability while remaining capable of incorporating justified correction?
core_rule: Never infer a downstream capability from an unvalidated upstream mechanism.

current_frontier.next_legitimate_action: Resolve the scientific-object meaning of evidence use before selecting an ontology or constructing the descendant evidence intervention space.

maturity_ladder.name: measurement_validity
maturity_ladder.criterion: The intended scientific object is identifiable under a prospectively declared measurement structure.

maturity_ladder.name: isolated_modification
maturity_ladder.criterion: Direct do(M=m) produces the warranted target effect while protected behavior remains within prospectively fixed tolerance.

maturity_ladder.name: extreme_adaptive_systems
maturity_ladder.note: AGI, recursive improvement, and ASI are stress-test regimes, not foundational objects.

fixed_design_principles: G2 is identified by independent direct do(M=m), not by conditioning on selected modifications.

forbidden_shortcuts: choose scientific object through benchmark convenience
repair a closed negative result under the same object identity
loosen a frozen gate after outcome
replace a policy-level estimand with a post-selected subset
infer capability or viability from upstream mechanism success
